prompt_md: You shuffle a standard 52-card deck. What's the chance that all four aces come before the first king?
prompt_short: Shuffled deck. All four aces before the first king?
hint_md: Ignore every card that isn't an ace or a king.
explain_intuition_md: Each ace seems to have an even chance against the kings, and multiplying four of those gives about 6%. But those events aren't independent. Look only at the 8 aces and kings: their order is random, and all four aces first is just one of 70 equally likely ace-king patterns.
